responsibility: This header declares the C interface for gm2 declaration construction. It provides prototypes for creating variables, constants, parameters, function declarations, module constructors, literal constants and strings, declaration-context queries, and machine-size helpers, serving as the declaration companion to the declaration-building implementation in m2decl.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header is the C/C++ prototype companion to m2decl.cc, declaring the declaration-building and literal-construction helpers for other gm2 native sources. Unlike m2decl.def it serves C/C++ callers rather than Modula-2 modules, and unlike m2decl.cc it contains no GCC tree-building implementation.
